title: Minor Arcana #20
desc:
Theresa tries to run from the pain of her past as The Lovers arc continues!

After impulsively running away from Limberlost, Theresa seeks refuge in Toronto with an old friend, hoping to escape her circumstances, and the dark figure following her.

But Theresa can't run forever, and no amount of hiding can stop the past from catching up with her. Will she learn the hard way that some memories are too much for one person to carry?
